messages:
josh: Seeing Console graphs fail for a subset of orgs — panels show spinning wheel then 500. Started ~02:12 UTC. Customer acme-inc escalated. Screenshot sent to #support-attached.

maria: Can you paste the root request id from the Console network tab? Also which panels are affected? A short repro helps.

josh: Quick curl I ran from support host:
```
curl -i -X POST https://analytics.api.redwood.ai/v1/query \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer xxxxx' \
  -d '{"org_id":"acme-inc","panel":"billing_usage","range":"1h"}'
```
Response:
```
HTTP/1.1 500 Internal Server Error
Content-Type: application/json
{"error":"aggregation_timeout","code":500,"request_id":"req_1797504321_ab12"}
```
Also some panels return 504 when the query runs longer than ~10s.

kevin: We promoted timeseries-aggregator v2 to canary/us-east-1 last night at 01:45 UTC as part of the rollup perf work. We've seen increased tail latency on wide-range queries with many series. Suspect the new streaming iterator path + concurrency is triggering remote fetch timeouts.

maria: I pulled metrics: analytics-api 5xx rate spiked at 02:12:10 UTC, matching the agg-rollup job window. Logs from analytics-api (excerpt):
```
ERROR [2026-03-17T02:12:15Z] aggregator/fetch.go:87 timeout fetching series: TimeoutError: read timed out
stack: aggregator.FetchSeries -> http.Client.Do
request_id=req_1797504321_ab12
```

kevin: Repro steps for eng: run a prod-range query hitting many partitions against timeseries-aggregator. I'll add a local repro harness. Mitigation options: 1) rollback v2 in us-east, 2) enable fallback to pre-aggregated legacy endpoint for Console queries for affected orgs.

lina: Customer acme-inc reported blank billing and token-usage panels. They requested ETA since finance dashboards are used for billing reconciliation.

josh: Can we do a rollback? If rollback will take longer, toggle fallback per-org while we investigate.

deploy-bot: Started rollback of analytics-aggregator to v1 in us-east-1 at 02:28 UTC :hammer_and_wrench:

infra-bot: Applied route annotation: `console.route=analytics-legacy` for org acme-inc (ttl=10m) — traffic diverted to legacy pre-aggregated endpoint.

maria: Post-rollback, 5xx rate dropped back to baseline within ~3 minutes. I retried the original curl and now get 200 with series payload.

josh: ACME confirmed billing panel now shows data. I sent a customer update and apology; they appreciate the quick remediation.

kevin: We'll gate v2 rollout until we have canary coverage for wide-range queries and add a per-query concurrency limiter + circuit breaker. Also add a synthetic test hitting high-series-count queries.

lina: I'll draft a short customer note and schedule a postmortem. We should include rollback criteria in the runbook.

josh: Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
